verdict.rationale: Stripe Connect's docs confirm the core capability: you create a charge, split it between the platform and sellers, and automatically pay a portion out to sellers. The pack does not show the multi-party or reversal parts of the story. Missing for 10: evidence of splitting one charge across multiple sellers, platform fees or transfers as first-class API objects, reversing or adjusting a split after the fact, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
